title: Kalshi daily volume of ‘perps’ trading begins to top its prediction markets
summary: Kalshi's recent introduction of perpetual contracts, known as 'perps', marks a significant expansion beyond traditional event contracts. Since their launch in May, these products have begun to attract considerable trading volume, surpassing that of Kalshi's existing prediction markets. This shift indicates a growing interest in innovative trading mechanisms that extend beyond conventional predictions, potentially reshaping the landscape of financial trading.
